data_properties.definition: A string code, recorded in a rail journey plan, that designates the planned rail service.
data_properties.label: has planned service code
data_properties.rationale: Scoped to the plan ICE. It does not reuse has_tail_number, has_ICAO_code, has_reservation_number, or person-name properties.

design_warnings: This is a candidate TBox design report only, not approved assertions and not OWL axioms.
Do not assert equivalence between proposed rail classes and Airplane, airport, Flight plan, ticket, boarding pass, reservation, passenger, or Jetblue passenger.
Rail passenger role is a BFO role, not a person and not a subclass of the supplied passenger class in this proposal.
Rail journey is a process; rail journey plan and rail reservation information are information content entities; rail ticket is proposed as a material bearer. Do not collapse them.

The local reservation class sits under material information bearer, while AgentOntology reservation sits under information content entity. The ICE parent was followed and the local error was not copied.
Do not create named individuals, social-media threat classifications, trip records, or statements about specific persons.
Do not copy has_departure_airport or has_arrival_airport as datatype properties, and do not introduce departure-station or arrival-station classes.
Imported building, ticket, pass, and passenger classes are thinly axiomatized. Alignment is provisional; missing canonical CCO IRIs were not invented.

has_journey_vehicle and specifies_journey may overlap BFO participation or IAO aboutness once those IRIs are supplied; revisit before commit and do not duplicate possesses, is_registered_guest, or agent in.
The service-code datatype property is a shorthand on the plan. Do not attach personal names, reservation numbers, or threat labels to roles, tickets, or journeys.

object_properties.definition: A relation between a rail journey and the railway station at which that journey begins.
object_properties.label: has departure station
object_properties.rationale: New process-to-facility relation. The source has_departure_airport datatype property is not reused, and departure is not modeled as a station subclass.

object_properties.definition: A relation between a rail journey and the railway station at which that journey ends.
object_properties.label: has arrival station
object_properties.rationale: New process-to-facility relation. The source has_arrival_airport datatype property is not reused.

object_properties.definition: A relation between a rail journey and the train that is the vehicle in that journey.
object_properties.label: has journey vehicle
object_properties.rationale: New process-to-vehicle relation. It is not a reuse of possesses, agent in, or any supplied affiliation property.

object_properties.definition: A relation between a rail journey plan and the rail journey process that the plan is about.
object_properties.label: specifies journey
object_properties.rationale: Keeps the plan ICE distinct from the journey process. An IAO aboutness IRI was not supplied, so this is a narrow candidate rather than an invented external property.

rail_classes.definition: An object that is a rail vehicle capable of traveling on a railway.
rail_classes.label: train
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. Airplane is parented by BFO object, so train is proposed under the same supplied object class rather than under an unsupplied vehicle or material-entity IRI.
review_notes: Comparison to Airplane is not an equivalence.
BFO material entity was not in the supplied vocabulary; object is used only because it is the supplied Airplane parent.
Do not mint named train individuals in this TBox stage.

rail_classes.definition: A train whose designed function is to carry passengers.
rail_classes.label: passenger train
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. The air pattern specializes a commercial airplane under Airplane, so passenger train is a proposed subclass of the proposed train class.
review_notes: The analogue IRI contains the spelling Commcercial; that typo must not be copied into the new local name.
Freight and mixed-traffic trains are intentionally out of scope.
Carrier-specific train classes are not proposed.

rail_classes.definition: A building at which trains stop so that passengers can board or alight.
rail_classes.label: railway station
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. The supplied airport class is a subclass of the supplied building class, so railway station follows that facility pattern.
review_notes: The imported building class may not be a canonical CCO facility IRI; do not invent a replacement CCO IRI.
A station site or spatial region should not be collapsed into the building if location is modeled later.
Do not subclass departure or arrival stations the way arrival_airport and departure_airport subclass airport; use relations instead.

rail_classes.definition: A process in which a train travels between railway stations.
rail_classes.label: rail journey
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. The target is the actual travel process, so the mandated parent is BFO process.
review_notes: No air-pattern analogue was supplied for this concept; do not treat Act of Flight Plan as an equivalent process.
Distinct from a journey plan, a reservation, and a ticket.
No trip-record individuals are proposed.

rail_classes.definition: An information content entity that specifies an intended rail journey and is not itself that journey.
rail_classes.label: rail journey plan
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. Flight plan is an information content entity, so the plan is an ICE and not a process.
review_notes: Comparison to Flight plan is not an equivalence.
Do not confuse this ICE with Act of Flight Plan, which is a process in the source.
A plan is not a reservation and not a material ticket.

rail_classes.definition: A ticket that is a material information bearer concretizing authorization to travel by rail.
rail_classes.label: rail ticket
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. The requested reading is a material bearer, and the supplied ticket class is already under material information bearer, matching concert ticket.
review_notes: If a later reading treats the ticket as pure information, the parent should be IAO information content entity instead of ticket.
boarding_pass is under pass, while ticket is a sibling material-bearer branch; those source classes are not equated here.
Do not create ticket individuals or person-specific ticket statements.

rail_classes.definition: Reservation information that records a booking for rail travel and is not a material ticket or a journey process.
rail_classes.label: rail reservation information
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. Airline reservation information specializes the supplied AgentOntology reservation class, which is an information content entity.
review_notes: The local intel-ontology reservation class is under material information bearer and must not be the parent.
AgentOntology reservation is the ICE parent used here; the local class is listed only as a supplied analogue.
Not a physical booking artifact and not a named reservation individual.

rail_classes.definition: A role borne by a person in virtue of traveling as a passenger on a rail journey.
rail_classes.label: rail passenger role
rail_classes.rationale: No exact-name match was supplied. The mandated parent is BFO role, not person and not the supplied passenger class.
review_notes: Parent is exactly BFO_0000023; this proposal does not subclass passenger or person.
A person bears the role; the role is not a kind of person.
Do not copy Jetblue_passenger into a carrier-specific or named passenger class.
